                                                          additional pipeline connections to mitigate undesirable deviations from the planned capture levels. These
                                                          indicate that incorporating uncertainties in CCUS network design and the planning of the deployment of
                                                          such infrastructure is important to reduce deviations from the expected capture amount as compared to a
